name: isr-exam-playwright-automation
description: Playwright TypeScript automation framework for the ISR technical exam web application.

scripts.test:auth: npm run clean:reports && playwright test tests/auth --project=chromium
scripts.test:known-bugs: npm run clean:reports && playwright test tests/known-bugs --project=chromium
scripts.test:demo-failure: npm run clean:reports && cross-env INCLUDE_DEMO_FAILURE=true playwright test tests/demo/failure-demo.spec.ts --project=chromium
